parsed.note_claim: Zohran Mamdani won NYC's mayoral election on Nov. 4, 2025, and becomes mayor on Jan. 1, 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Mamdani succeeded Democratic incumbent Eric Adams on January 1, 2026, becoming the first Muslim and first South Asian mayor of New York City
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states the date Mamdani succeeds the incumbent as mayor, confirming the note's correction that he is not yet mayor in December 2025.
